paite: Aw sepaih hon tanu, tuin sepaih honin kikaikhawm inla: aman a hohumta ahi: Israelte vaihawmpa a biangah chiangin khen in.
english: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.

paite: Himahleh nang Bethlehem Ephratha, Juda gama sang tampi laka tel din neu tawk le chin leng, nanga kipanin Israelte vai hawmpa ding kei din a hongpawt ding; a hongpawtna sawtpi, tangali nite akipan ahi.
english: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come forth to me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth are from of old, from everlasting.

paite: Huaijiakin nauveimiin a suahsak ma tenin amau a lehngat san ding: huchiin a unau om sunte Israel suante kiangah a kik nawn ding.
english: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.

paite: Amah a ding dinga, TOUPA a Pathian min thupina ngeiin: huan, amau a om nilouhta ding ua: amah leh lei tawp phain a thupi sin ta ngal a.
english: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God: and they will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.

paite: Huan, hiai mi kilepna ahi ding; Assuria mi gam ua a hong, i kumpipa uh inte a honsik hun chiangin, amah dou dingin belampu sagih leh mi thupi giat i kidok khe ding.
english: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land, and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.

paite: Assuria gam bel namsauin a hihse ding ua, Nimrod gam a lutnaah a hihse lai ding uh: huan, aman, i gam ua Assuria mi honga, i gam chiang uh a hongsik hunin, amah akipanin a hohhon khe ding.
english: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.

paite: Jakobte mi om sunte chi tampi lakah TOUPA akipana dai kia bang leh loupa tunga vuah ju bangin a om ding uh; huaiin mihing a ngak keia, mihing tapate a ngak sam kei hi.
english: The remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples, like dew from Yahweh, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for man, nor wait for the sons of men.

paite: Jokobte mi om sunte namte lakah leh chi tampite lakah gamnuai sate laka humpinelkai bang leh belam hon laka humpinelkai lenlai bangin a om ding: aman, a pai suak peuhmah le, a sik den a, a bot nena, humbit ding leng kuamah a om kei uh.
english: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.

paite: Na khut nang hon doute tungah likin om henla, na melma tengteng hihmanin om hen.
english: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.

paite: Huai ni chaingin hichi ahi dinga, TOUPAN a chi, nanga kipanin na sakolte ka hihmang dinga, na kangtalaite ka hihse ding:
english: “It will happen in that day,” says Yahweh, “That I will cut off your horses out of the midst of you, and will destroy your chariots.

paite: Na khopite ka hihmang dinga, na kulh hat tengteng ka hihchim ding;
english: I will cut off the cities of your land, and will tear down all your strongholds.

paite: Na khut akipan bumsiamnate ka hihmang dinga; aisansiamte ka hihmang dinga; aisansiamte na nei nawnta kei ding:
english: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand; and you shall have no soothsayers.

paite: Nang akipan na milim bawl tawmte leh na suang phuhte ka hihmang dinga; na khut suak thil na be nawnta kei ding.
english: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars out of your midst; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.

paite: Nang akipan na Aser te ka bot khe dinga; na khopite ka hihse ding.Huan, thu ngaikhe lou namte tungah hehna leh thangpaihnain phu lakna ka piching sak ding.
english: I will uproot your Asherim out of your midst; and I will destroy your cities.

paite: Huan, thu ngaikhe lou namte tungah hehna leh thangpaihnain phu lakna ka piching sak ding.
english: I will execute vengeance in anger, and wrath on the nations that didn’t listen.”
